{"verdict":"ANSWER","answer":"Direction: make the first viewport a single "Backing card" whose only job is to answer "how much of this is really mine, and how much is someone else's promise?" Everything else demotes.

FIRST VIEWPORT (desktop and mobile, same DOM order)
1. Header row: EntitySwitcher + shield icon-btn (unchanged, ui/src/screens/Home.tsx:76-98).
2. Hero: label "Your money" + the figure, but the hero becomes `wallet.usd.secured + onchain + reserve`-free of invention: keep the exact same `visibleNet`/`visibleUsd` expression you already compute (Home.tsx:48-51) as the hero number, and immediately under it a one-line sublabel with the two existing truths: `Available to pay: … · includes available credit` (Home.tsx:146-154). Do not add percentages.
3. The bar, promoted: move `<BalanceDetails>` (currently rendered at Home.tsx:196, after actions and three accordions) to sit directly under the hero, and render its existing `<Bar segments>` at `height={8}` instead of the 6px default (ui/src/components/Bars.tsx:27-41). Same segments, same kinds, same `--ppu` global scale, so cross-row comparability is untouched (WalletScale.tsx:8-25).
4. Two stat cells under the bar, side by side on desktop, stacked on mobile: "Secured by collateral" (`wallet.usd.secured`, `c-coll`) and "Promise only" (`wallet.usd.risk`, `c-risk`) — these already exist as `home-secured`/`home-risk` parts (BalanceDetails.tsx:10-24). Add a third, visually separated cell below a hairline: "Credit room (not your money)" using the existing `c-room` ghost token.
5. Actions: one primary `Pay`, plus `Receive` and `Swap` as text-weight buttons (`btn quiet sm`), reusing existing handlers (Home.tsx:160-192). The 6-item nav collapses to a single "More" disclosure containing the same six entries; drop the two extra accordions (`Learn the wallet functions`, `Backup and dispute protection`, Home.tsx:194-206) into that one disclosure. Net code reduction, no new components.

BACKING VS CAPACITY, VISIBLY
- Backing (onchain/reserve/coll) is solid fill; capacity (`room`) is rendered outside the filled bar: add `.bar .seg.c-room { background: transparent; border: 1px dashed var(--room); }` and place room segments after a `.bar::after` hairline divider. Filled = recoverable, outlined = conditional. Tokens already exist (tokens.css: `--coll`, `--risk`, `--room`).
- Never include `room` in the hero figure; it stays only in the "Available to pay" line and the outlined tail, which matches "unused credit is not wealth".
- Risk (`c-risk`) stays violet and solid but gets a 2px top inset stripe so colorblind users distinguish it from collateral without relying on hue.

CONCRETE CSS/COMPONENT CHANGES
- `Bar`: no API change; pass `height={8}` from BalanceDetails.
- `BalanceDetails.tsx`: reorder so `<Bar>` renders before the heading; wrap the parts list in `.backing-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px } @media (max-width:520px){ grid-template-columns:1fr }`.
- Hero font: replace inline `fontSize: 52` (Home.tsx:137) with a class using `clamp(34px, 9vw, 56px)` so narrow mobile does not wrap a long bigint.
- Keyboard/touch: stat cells remain non-interactive text (bars are `aria-hidden`, so the numeric parts must stay readable text — they already are). Keep min 44px tap height on the three actions; the "More" disclosure is a native `<details>`, so it is focusable and announced.
- Preserve `places`, `scaleMode`, `selectedToken`, `showZero` state and all `data-testid`s so settings and tests survive.

EDGE CASES
1. `lendingUnavailable` or `!wallet.frame`: hero falls back to the existing status line (Home.tsx:134-143); render the bar as a neutral `c-slate` skeleton rather than a stale filled bar.
2. All-credit wallet (secured = 0, risk = 0, room > 0): bar shows only the outlined tail — hero reads 0 while "Available to pay" is positive. Add copy "No money backing this yet".
3. `wallet.usd.owed > 0` with per-token selection: the existing owed note (BalanceDetails.tsx:73-78) must stay adjacent to the bar, and `c-debt` must not be merged into collateral; also guard `places.*` toggles hiding all segments (empty `parts` ⇒ zero-length bar, which would skew `WalletScale` fit; skip emitting `data-bar-usd` when total is 0).","references":["ui/src/screens/Home.tsx:48","ui/src/screens/Home.tsx:134","ui/src/screens/Home.tsx:146","ui/src/screens/Home.tsx:160","ui/src/screens/Home.tsx:194","ui/src/screens/Home.tsx:196","ui/src/components/home/BalanceDetails.tsx:10","ui/src/components/home/BalanceDetails.tsx:73","ui/src/components/Bars.tsx:27","ui/src/components/home/WalletScale.tsx:8","ui/src/styles/tokens.css:1"]}
